unidentifiedbrokerageapp.name: Unidentified brokerage app
unidentifiedbrokerageapp.used_for: account value, return and per-position gain/loss screenshots

x.name: X
x.used_for: posting and showing the holdings table

cnbc.name: CNBC
cnbc.used_for: market commentary segments with a live index and yield ticker

tradingview.name: TradingView
tradingview.used_for: price charts, P/E ratio pane, Bollinger Bands and VIX chart

unidentifiedoptionsbroker.name: Unidentified options broker
unidentifiedoptionsbroker.used_for: options chain with delta, mid price and ROI

unusualwhales.name: Unusual Whales
unusualwhales.used_for: market tide, sentiment gauge and GEX market maker data

unidentifiedchartingsite.name: Unidentified charting site
unidentifiedchartingsite.used_for: breadth, RSI, VIX/VXN and QQQ charts

otu.name: OTU
otu.used_for: options sentiment dashboard (market tide, fear/greed) and dark pool block trades

rateofreturn.name: Rate of return
rateofreturn.how_used: 3-year return shown on the account chart

dailygainloss.name: Daily gain/loss
dailygainloss.measures: dollar and percent move of each position today
dailygainloss.how_used: to see what drove the day

totalgainlosspercent.name: Total gain/loss percent
totalgainlosspercent.measures: return of a position since purchase
totalgainlosspercent.how_used: to compare how far each holding has run

positionvalue.name: Position value
positionvalue.measures: current dollar size of a holding
positionvalue.how_used: to gauge sizing within the account

positionsize.name: Position size
positionsize.measures: share of capital in a stock
positionsize.how_used: judged across all portfolios, not one

aaiisentimentsurvey.name: AAII sentiment survey
aaiisentimentsurvey.how_used: cited by a panelist as rock-bottom sentiment; creator takes it as a contrarian reason to stay invested

100daymovingaverage.name: 100-day moving average
100daymovingaverage.how_used: cited by a CNBC panelist as where the market bottomed before the Fed meeting

10yeartreasuryyield.name: 10-year Treasury yield
10yeartreasuryyield.how_used: read from the CNBC ticker (4.974%) as a market backdrop

peratio.name: P/E ratio
peratio.measures: price relative to earnings per share
peratio.how_used: must be positive and ideally under 100

earningsbeats.name: Earnings beats
earningsbeats.how_used: needs a consistent streak (five straight for CRDO)

vix.name: VIX
vix.how_used: bands map to cash versus invested percent; low VIX means greed and more cash

bollingerbands.name: Bollinger Bands
bollingerbands.measures: statistical price range (about 95% of the time)
bollingerbands.how_used: outside-band moves tend to revert; upper band means more risk when selling puts

delta.name: Delta
delta.measures: option sensitivity and rough assignment probability
delta.how_used: 25-30 delta for puts and 30 delta for calls

thetadecay.name: Theta decay
thetadecay.how_used: sell within the 60-day window where decay is fastest

premiumroi.name: Premium ROI
premiumroi.measures: option premium as percent of capital at risk

adjustedebitda.name: Adjusted EBITDA
adjustedebitda.measures: operating cash earnings before depreciation and amortization
adjustedebitda.how_used: Used instead of net income for Wynn's properties.

50daymovingaverage.name: 50-day moving average
50daymovingaverage.how_used: share of stocks above it for breadth; pullback target on single stocks

20daymovingaverage.name: 20-day moving average
20daymovingaverage.how_used: listed with other averages and VWAP for GLW

vwap.name: VWAP
vwap.how_used: yearly VWAP as a level to eye for put strikes

callwall.name: Call wall
callwall.measures: strike with large call gamma, resistance

putwall.name: Put wall
putwall.measures: strike with large put gamma, support

vxn.name: VXN
vxn.how_used: preferred read of tech fear; drives cash allocation bands
